verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a cloud-storage SaaS with a developer platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only SDKs (Swift, .NET, Java, JavaScript, Python), HTTP APIs and webhooks. None of it mentions a first-party command-line tool. SDKs are developer building blocks and earn no credit toward an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
